Player Impressions:
Hoyos:  Nothing disasterous yet
Edwards:  Good going forward, but a few clumsy tackles.  In danger of being the first with a 🟨.
Mihaj: doing well in the back
Jacob: good in the back, getting up occasionally
Muyumba:  providing a good outlet.  Doing well coming back in defense.  
Fortune:  Was showing his normal spark until the injury
Sanchez:  Looking dangerous.  Really coming into his own.  
Reilly:  A depth piece.  Doesn't always show up in the right space, but tries reall hard.
Brennan:  Getting bodied off the ball all too often.  Clearly outmatched.  His progress has leveled off.  Another game where he needs to shine, and he's wilting.  Time to move on.
Almirón:  Trying to be the emotional leader.  Have to wonder how much he'll have in the tank.
Miranchuk:  He was playing deeper as the half went on.  He looked more dangerous when he was higher up the pitch.

I am expecting Latte Lath to come on as a winger at some point.  For either Brennan, or Almirón if he's tired.

Player Impressions:
Hoyos:  Caught off by the goal.  He couldn't have gotten it.  Came up big in the 2nd half, kept the game close.
Edwards:  Pushed up high.  Overall getting better passes than he used to.
Mihaj: Good in the back.  Placing long balls well.
Jacob: Did well enough as a CB.  
Muyumba:  Did pretty well tonight.  Worked hard throughout the full game. 
Sanchez:  Wasn't as dominant in the 2nd half.   
Reilly:  Was outmatched a bit.
Brennan:  Clearly outmatched.  Another game where he needs to shine, and he's wilting.  Time to move on from him.
Almirón:  Trying to be the emotional leader.  He ran out of steam for a while.  But came on strong towards the end.  Works hard, but his age is catching up to him.
Miranchuk:  Played deeper in the 2nd half.  Wasn't as impactful.  
Latte Lath:  Another poor showing.  Got into a perfect place.  No excuse for not putting the ball on target, even if stopped.
Palacios again having issues with another Atlanta player.  He has been angry since coming on.
